template.name: Mindray TE Air Ultrasound
template.desc: Converted from the CHS Ansur template “0000 - 000000000000 Te Air EST dd.mm.yyyy.mtt” (file name). Electrical safety to AS/NZS 3551:2012+A2. The ESA612 steps are put in the usual order (they were patient leakage first in Ansur). Not checked against a manufacturer manual (the Mindray Animal manuals folder has none for this model): the checks and the applied part type are as in the Ansur template, for Jonathan to confirm against the device label and the service manual.

items: Check Probe Charges on Cable and in Capsule if Purchased (charge to 100%)
Activate and Check Additional Options if Purchased

steps.title: Mains voltage
steps.instructions: Plug the ESA612 into the mains supply you are testing from.

steps.title: Insulation: mains to protective earth
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet and switch the device on. Don’t touch the device during the test.

steps.title: Enclosure leakage
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet. Clip the red test lead to an unearthed part of the enclosure.
